acts.name: Streamlined Energy and Carbon Reporting (SECR)
acts.scope: Scope 1, 2, 3 carbon footprint disclosures and energy efficiency requirements.

acts.name: UK Data Protection Act 2018 / UK GDPR
acts.scope: Stringent personal data handling, ICO registration, and cross-border transfer standards.

acts.name: Enterprise Investment Scheme (EIS / SEIS)
acts.scope: Tax relief mechanisms for angel investors in UK early-stage startups (up to 50% income tax relief).

acts.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act)
acts.scope: Risk classification for AI systems (High Risk vs Transparency vs Minimal Risk), algorithmic audit trails.

acts.name: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
acts.scope: User consent, right to erasure, DPO requirements, and severe non-compliance fines up to 4% global turnover.

acts.name: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA / CPRA)
acts.scope: Consumer data transparency, opt-out rights, and data processing governance.

acts.name: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
acts.scope: Protected Health Information (PHI) encryption, BAA agreements, and access logs.

acts.name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023)
acts.scope: Consent management, data fiduciary obligations, and penalties for biometric/financial data leaks.

acts.name: Startup India Scheme
acts.scope: Section 80-IAC tax exemptions for DPIIT recognized startups and angel tax reliefs.
